preconditions.name: enough_divergent_seeds
preconditions.description: number of seeds whose candidate pool is DIVERGENT on BOTH arms >= MIN_DIVERGENT_SEEDS. Per-seed-divergent gating; too few => substrate_not_ready_requeue.
preconditions.control: consumed cand_world_summary pairwise spread > floor (GAP-A); per-seed

preconditions.name: loops_carry_live_cross_loop_variance
preconditions.description: ARC-110 NON-DEGENERACY guard: on BOTH loop arms a non-motor loop FLIPS the within-eligible winner or the loops DISAGREE on a non-trivial fraction of P2 ticks, AND a non-motor loop carries per-loop preference RANGE > 0, on a majority of seeds. A loop pinned to the motor winner is a vacuous split.
preconditions.control: loop_frac_committed_neq_motor / loop_frac_disagree + per-loop pref range (both arms)

preconditions.name: named_channel_routing_live
preconditions.description: 707b C2-release non-degeneracy: on the LEARNED arm at least one LIMBIC channel (ofc/liking/vigour) reaches the arbitration carrying routed per-candidate RANGE > LIMBIC_ROUTED_RANGE_FLOOR (peak over P2 ticks), on a strict-majority of DIVERGENT seeds. Without live limbic range the arbitration has no limbic signal to learn to route through (the MECH-191 phasic gap). measured = max across LEARNED seeds of the limbic routed range; SAME statistic (per-candidate range) the conversion depends on, not a magnitude proxy.
preconditions.control: LEARNED loop_limbic_routed_range_max (peak limbic routed per-candidate range over P2)

preconditions.name: learned_cross_loop_weights_moved_off_init
preconditions.description: ARC-108 x ARC-110 MECHANISM non-vacuity (W): on the LEARNED arm the learned cross-loop matrix M_cross MOVED off its zero init -- loop_cross_loop_m_range (per-tick) AND post_action_update clg_m_cross_range both > M_CROSS_RANGE_FLOOR AND clg_n_updates > 0 -- on a strict-majority of DIVERGENT seeds. At init M_cross==0 -> W_cross==I -> LEARNED is BIT-IDENTICAL to STATIC; if the weights never moved a 'no lift' is meaningless => substrate_not_ready_requeue (NEVER a weakens). measured = max across LEARNED seeds of the peak M_cross range; SAME statistic (M_cross range) the mechanism depends on.

preconditions.name: limbic_loop_parity_win
preconditions.description: THE LOAD-BEARING gate (the 711 autopsy target), NOW SATURATION-GUARDED: on the A_ASCENDING_ON arm the limbic loop's effective column weight w_eff[limbic] (from the PARITY-CONTROLLED W_cross) reaches a FAIR PARITY WIN -- it enters the parity BAND (w_eff[motor] <= w_eff[limbic] <= PARITY_BAND_HI x w_eff[motor]) on >= 1 P2 tick AND does NOT blow up (w_eff/M_cross under the saturation ceiling) -- on a STRICT-MAJORITY (>= LIMBIC_WIN_PASS_FRACTION = 3/4) of DIVERGENT seeds. This is the exact repair of the 711 hole: the raw scalar met a BARE w_eff[limbic] >= w_eff[motor] via a 10-2274x MONOPOLY (saturation), which the band+ceiling now rejects. If the controller cannot deliver a fair parity win on >= 3/4 divergent seeds (lift too weak), the conversion question is not measured => substrate_not_ready_requeue, NEVER a weakens. measured = n divergent seeds with a fair parity win; SAME statistic (effective column weight) the conversion depends on.
preconditions.control: A_ASCENDING_ON clg_limbic_parity_win (band win AND not saturated) over P2

preconditions.name: no_saturation_blowup
preconditions.description: SATURATION GUARD (the load-bearing 711 repair): the number of DIVERGENT seeds on the A_ASCENDING_ON arm whose arbitration BLEW UP -- w_eff[limbic] peak past SATURATION_W_EFF_CEILING x w_eff[motor] peak, or M_cross range peak past SATURATION_M_CROSS_CEILING -- must be ZERO (upper-bound: measured <= threshold). Any saturated seed means a limbic MONOPOLY (not a fair win) and the conversion was tested under a degenerate arbitration => substrate_not_ready_requeue, NEVER a decisive FAIL/weakens. With a correctly tuned controller this is always 0.
preconditions.control: A_ASCENDING_ON clg_saturated count over divergent seeds (0 expected)

preconditions.name: learning_engaged_finer_channels_dissociable_delta_nonflat
preconditions.description: on BOTH arms the finer w_chan_finer entries MOVED + carry cross-channel range above floor AND the signed-RPE delta_t carries cross-tick variance, on a majority of seeds -- learning is engaged. Below floor => substrate_not_ready_requeue.

preconditions.name: candidate_pool_divergent
preconditions.description: consumed cand_world_summaries (e2.world_forward) per-candidate SPREAD clears the floor on a majority of seeds (GAP-A non-vacuity).
preconditions.control: SD-056 e2 trained online in P0; candidate_summary_source=e2_world_forward
